text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did I scare ya? Pretty good playing 
dead, huh! When I was little, the 
neighborhood kids and I used to play 
superheroes like this all the time.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pretend to be knocked down, and when 
the enemy gets close, I'll slash them in 
one strike! That's the plan!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I got so good at playing along that adults 
were actually called on me once, though... 
—Wanna see me do it again?
